commands.checks: Every accepted layout has G >= 256 because ell and ceil(log2(p+2)) are at least 2. The factored window term is then strictly less than 3, so C = 3 r_max / p works at r = r_max. The equality witness p=1, ell=2 has G=256 and C=6. Layouts with ell=1 are rejected. Under L <= p the same C is strictly below 1/6400.
